Hi Rodrigo, it's Claire. I listened to your update at the forum last week. It was short and very clear. Thank you! Last month you had some problems with transport, but you finished on time. Next month I am going to visit Brazil with two people from Paris. We are going to see the plant on Tuesday. See you soon!

Hi Rodrigo, Tom here, from New Jersey. Some news from the plant. We usually have three trucks a day, but this week we are receiving five. It is a busy week! Last Friday we had a problem with a machine, but it is OK now. And good news: you are going to visit our plant on October twenty-eighth. I am going to show you the new warehouse. Talk soon.

On Day 1, Rodrigo made a short recording. He was nervous, and his sentences were very long. For twenty lessons he practiced the past, the present and the future. Today his sentences are short, and he is more confident. In October he is going to speak English in New York.
